principles: AI foreslår altid det bedste næste skridt.
Brugeren må aldrig være i tvivl om status eller resultat.
Tekniske begreber skjules, indtil de er nødvendige.
Én tydelig primær handling pr. skærm.
Alle AI-processer viser aktivitet, resultat og næste handling.
Platformversion, arbejdsændringer og udgivet indhold er tre forskellige ting.
Review er en tilstand, ikke en ekstra knap: brugeren ser og retter resultatet direkte.
Efter hver afsluttet handling gives en konkret instruktion i almindeligt dansk.
Godkendelse og offentliggørelse er adskilte trin.
Udgivelse indeholder hele det aktuelle workspace: både AI's arbejde og brugerens egne rettelser.
Lange processer viser løbende aktivitet og seneste aktivitetstidspunkt.
canonical_workflow: Mission Control bekræfter den live indholdsversion

release_center.passive_polling: once per hour while Mission Control is open
release_center.workspace_reset: only when expected content_version is confirmed live

single_version_source.rule: All user-visible platform, build and worker values must load from this file.
single_version_source.consistency_check: UI values are populated after manifest load; no page owns a separate version value.

live_workspace_reconciliation.rule: Only workspace values included in the confirmed release are cleared.
live_workspace_reconciliation.newer_edits: Preserved if their current value differs from the release snapshot.

platform_supervisor.routing: no custom redirects and no URL rewriting

verified_publish.user_facing_count: Counts workspace changes, not generated files.
verified_publish.workspace_reset: Only after the full live gate passes.

platform_status_consistency.public_badge: version and formatted build date both bound to platform-manifest selectors
platform_status_consistency.knowledge_center: shows build date, verified-live date and plain-language public verification status
platform_status_consistency.legacy_release_status: explicitly labelled as not verified with the newer method

knowledge_center_start_position.publish_view: release center only when navigation explicitly targets #publish
knowledge_center_start_position.active_release: release center while a publish session is prepared, in GitHub, deploying or verifying
knowledge_center_start_position.completed_release: returns to top; release receipt remains accessible below

version_cache_sync.admin_shell: versioned query parameter on every HTML page
version_cache_sync.goal: Public website and Knowledge Center must show the same platform version and build timestamp immediately after deployment.

authoritative_route_sync.extensionless_routes: Worker internally serves the corresponding current .html asset; no redirects.
authoritative_route_sync.consistency_gate: Version, build and worker must match before the status is accepted.
authoritative_route_sync.cache_strategy: Release-specific shell/manifest URLs plus no-store headers.
authoritative_route_sync.diagnostics: Visible warning if the deployed files do not belong to the same release.

version_label_clarity.current_platform: Clearly labelled as Platformen du bruger nu.
version_label_clarity.historical_platform: Clearly labelled as Denne udgivelse blev lavet med.
version_label_clarity.current_source: Current platform manifest and Worker metadata.
version_label_clarity.goal: Prevent historical release receipts from being mistaken for the active platform version.

release_center_version_model.current_platform_panel: Always populated from the current platform shell/manifest.
release_center_version_model.historical_receipt_panel: Always populated from the saved release session.
release_center_version_model.separation: Two distinct visual cards with independent labels and data sources.
release_center_version_model.goal: A historical release can never visually masquerade as the active platform.

canonical_mission_control.reason: A brand-new asset name prevents an old Knowledge Center HTML file from being mistaken for the current UI.
canonical_mission_control.historical_data: Still displayed only inside the explicitly historical release receipt.
canonical_mission_control.build_timestamp: Generated from the actual package creation time in Europe/Copenhagen.

release_compatibility_engine.incompatible_action: Pause package, preserve it as history, and build a new package from the current approved workspace.
release_compatibility_engine.integrity: SHA-256 checksum for every generated file.

autonomous_publish_supervisor.countdown: Neutral second-by-second countdown to next automatic check.
autonomous_publish_supervisor.resume: When the tab becomes visible again, an overdue check runs immediately.
autonomous_publish_supervisor.limitation: Browser JavaScript cannot continue while the browser is fully closed; monitoring resumes on return.

completion_timestamp_model.primary_platform_time: First successful manifest/Worker consistency confirmation for the current version.
completion_timestamp_model.display_rule: Primary status always pairs a completion timestamp with a version number.
completion_timestamp_model.honesty_note: The browser can prove the platform was complete at the confirmation time, but cannot know an earlier Cloudflare completion instant.

active_content_release_lifecycle.platform_update_behavior: Never activates or resumes content publishing.
active_content_release_lifecycle.legacy_session_migration: Preserved as historical receipt and deactivated.
active_content_release_lifecycle.idle_ui: Shows clear status and one recommended CTA; hides progress, polling and compatibility panels.
active_content_release_lifecycle.completion: Live releases become inactive immediately after verified completion.

canonical_url_and_idle_state.worker_behavior: Every historical Mission Control URL serves the current canonical asset.
canonical_url_and_idle_state.browser_behavior: Address bar is replaced with the current canonical path.
canonical_url_and_idle_state.update_button: Navigates to the new canonical page rather than reloading the old URL.
canonical_url_and_idle_state.idle_behavior: Historical content releases never activate progress or monitoring.

stable_control_route.legacy_behavior: HTTP 302 redirect before old page render
stable_control_route.reason: The administration URL no longer changes per release.

static_control_entry.reason: Works even when old static assets are served before Worker routing.

redirect_loop_fix.cause: A redirect rule for /control could also match /control.html and redirect it to itself.
redirect_loop_fix.fix: Removed the /control rule from _redirects. /control.html is now the only stable static entry.
redirect_loop_fix.worker: Only /control redirects once; /control.html is served directly.
redirect_loop_fix.legacy: Old versioned pages still redirect to /control.html.

directory_control_entry.why: Cloudflare can normalize .html URLs to extensionless URLs. A directory index avoids that collision.
directory_control_entry.worker: Does not intercept /control/; static index is served directly.

foundation.deployment: Replace repository contents with this package

canonical_workspace_state.legacy_state: Backed up once and excluded from active counts
